raw_response:
This bar chart illustrates the "effect" values across various language families and isolates, comparing six different models: mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂, as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into nine groups: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, with each group containing six bars representing the models. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 10, and each bar is accompanied by error bars indicating variability. The bars are color-coded: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). In most groups, the bars are arranged side by side in this fixed order. Notable patterns include the IE-Indic group showing the highest effect values, especially for mBERT-R₂ (around 20), mBERT-B₂ (around 24), and XLM-B₂ (around 21), while the Isolate and Uralic groups show consistently low effect values near zero across all models. The Semitic group shows moderate to high values for mBERT-L₂ (around 11), XLM-L₂ (around 16), and XLM-B₂ (around 20), with large error bars indicating high variability. The IE-Germanic and IE-Slavic family groups show moderate values, with XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ generally higher than others. No bars are sorted by height within groups, and no visual emphasis such as shading or annotations is applied beyond the standard bar and error bar presentation.
